enhancements.compatibility_text: Any armor that normally imposes Stealth Disadvantage
enhancements.name: Silent Lacing
enhancements.preferred_materials: Cloud silk, moon silver thread, hidden brigandine
enhancements.text: The armor does not impose Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

enhancements.name: Weightless Harness
enhancements.preferred_materials: Cloud silk, cloud-void crystal, rattan-bamboo
enhancements.text: The armor weighs half as much as normal. You ignore its Strength requirement when determining whether it reduces your Speed.

enhancements.name: Sure-Strap Inscription
enhancements.preferred_materials: Spirit iron, blood jade, layered leather
enhancements.text: The item cannot be removed, disarmed, or dropped against your will while you are conscious.

enhancements.name: Quick-Release Clasps
enhancements.preferred_materials: Spirit iron, voidglass, paper-lamellar
enhancements.text: Donning or doffing the item takes half the normal time. If another feature already halves that time, it instead takes one-quarter the normal time.

enhancements.name: Restful Inner Robe
enhancements.preferred_materials: Cloud silk, battle cotton, phoenix-ash silk
enhancements.text: You can complete a Long Rest while wearing the armor without suffering a penalty solely from sleeping in armor.

enhancements.compatibility_text: Light or medium armor; concealable heavy armor by explicit formula
enhancements.name: Hidden Plates Glamour
enhancements.preferred_materials: Moon silver thread, paper-lamellar, voidglass
enhancements.text: As a Bonus Action, make the armor appear to be ordinary clothing of the same general size. Physical inspection reveals the armor. A creature studying it from sight alone must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your item save DC.

enhancements.name: Helmet-Seal Inscription
enhancements.preferred_materials: Spirit iron, mountain jade, dragon scale
enhancements.text: When a critical hit is scored against you, you can cause it to become a normal hit. Once used, this property cannot be used again until you complete a Long Rest.

enhancements.name: Padded Impact Layers
enhancements.preferred_materials: Battle cotton, beast hide, world-turtle shell
enhancements.text: Reduce falling and collision damage you take by your Proficiency Bonus. Reduce bludgeoning damage from unattended falling objects by the same amount.

enhancements.name: Fire-Shedding Lining
enhancements.preferred_materials: Sun copper, phoenix-ash silk, fireproof hide
enhancements.text: Reduce fire damage you take by your Proficiency Bonus. This reduction applies after Resistance.

enhancements.name: Frost-Shedding Lining
enhancements.preferred_materials: Frost jade, deepsea cold iron, winter beast fur
enhancements.text: Reduce cold damage you take by your Proficiency Bonus. This reduction applies after Resistance.

enhancements.name: Lightning-Grounding Mesh
enhancements.preferred_materials: Storm iron, tribulation steel, spirit copper
enhancements.text: Reduce lightning damage you take by your Proficiency Bonus. This reduction applies after Resistance.

enhancements.compatibility_text: Any armor with a collar, mask, hood, or helmet
enhancements.name: Poison-Filtering Collar
enhancements.preferred_materials: Medicine jade, purified silver, beast filters
enhancements.text: You have Advantage on saving throws against inhaled poison and the Poisoned condition caused by an inhaled effect.

enhancements.compatibility_text: Cloth, layered, hidden, or helmeted armor
enhancements.name: Sound-Dampening Felt
enhancements.preferred_materials: Hush felt, cloud silk, black bamboo fiber
enhancements.text: The armor produces no sound from plates, rings, lacing, or movement. This does not silence your voice, footsteps on noisy terrain, weapons, or impacts.

enhancements.name: Water-Sealed Weave
enhancements.preferred_materials: River jade, lacquered hide, water silk
enhancements.text: The armor functions normally underwater, never becomes waterlogged, and protects ordinary worn clothing and papers beneath it from rain and brief immersion.

enhancements.name: Featherfall Skirt
enhancements.preferred_materials: Cloud silk, feathered jade, spirit bamboo
enhancements.text: When you fall, reduce the distance used to calculate falling damage by 30 feet. You land on your feet if you are not Incapacitated.

enhancements.name: Dark-Sight Visor
enhancements.preferred_materials: Moon silver, ghost iron, dark crystal
enhancements.text: While the visor is worn, you have Darkvision out to 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet.

enhancements.name: Qi-Conductive Lacing
enhancements.preferred_materials: Spirit iron, spirit silk, heaven-mark gold
enhancements.text: You can use the armor as a focus for Sphere actions and treasures that require a worn focus. Wearing it does not interfere with somatic movement required by a Tianxia technique.

enhancements.name: Talisman Socket
enhancements.preferred_materials: White jade, paper-lamellar, spirit iron
enhancements.text: During a Short or Long Rest, attach one consumable talisman to the item. You can activate it without holding it in a free hand. The item can hold only one talisman at a time.

enhancements.name: Formation-Guard Stitching
enhancements.preferred_materials: Formation jade, spirit thread, source stone
enhancements.text: You have Advantage on saving throws against harmful effects created by a Formation Anchor you can see within 30 feet.

enhancements.name: Beast-Scent Masking
enhancements.preferred_materials: Spirit-beast hide, cloud silk, scentless lacquer
enhancements.text: Creatures relying primarily on smell have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks made to detect or track you.

enhancements.name: Self-Mending Lacquer
enhancements.preferred_materials: Phoenix ash, living lacquer, spirit iron
enhancements.text: During a Short Rest, the item repairs all ordinary dents, cuts, torn straps, scorch marks, and cosmetic damage. This does not restore a destroyed item or remove a supernatural flaw.

enhancements.name: Meridian-Clear Underlayer
enhancements.preferred_materials: Medicine silk, spirit cotton, meridian thread
enhancements.text: You have Advantage on saving throws against effects that would prevent you from spending CP, Stamina, or Resonance.

enhancements.compatibility_text: Metal, plate, lamellar, ring, or shield
enhancements.name: Anti-Corrosion Temper
enhancements.preferred_materials: Spirit iron, purified silver, alchemical lacquer
enhancements.text: The item is immune to nonmagical rust and corrosion. You have Advantage on saving throws against effects that specifically corrode or destroy worn armor.

enhancements.name: Grasp-Breaking Plates
enhancements.preferred_materials: Mountain jade, smooth plate, voidglass
enhancements.text: You have Advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a Grapple.

enhancements.name: Pilgrim's Pocket Lining
enhancements.preferred_materials: Voidglass, folded silk, spatial jade
enhancements.text: The armor contains extradimensional pockets holding up to 50 pounds or 5 cubic feet. Retrieving a hand-held object requires a Bonus Action. Living creatures cannot enter the pockets.

enhancements.compatibility_text: Mirror, plate, lamellar, or ceremonial armor
enhancements.name: Rank-Bearing Mirror Plates
enhancements.preferred_materials: Mirror-sea silver, sun copper, polished jade
enhancements.text: You have Advantage on Charisma checks made to display recognized military, sect, clan, court, or ancestral authority while the armor is visible. This property does not create authority you do not possess.

enhancements.name: Elemental Resistance Weave
enhancements.preferred_materials: A material aligned with the chosen element
enhancements.text: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder when the enhancement is created. You have Resistance to the chosen damage type.

enhancements.name: Force-Dispersal Circuit
enhancements.preferred_materials: Voidglass, mountain jade, spirit iron
enhancements.text: You have Resistance to force damage. If another property already grants this Resistance, reduce force damage you take by your Proficiency Bonus after applying Resistance.

enhancements.compatibility_text: Mirror, plate, shield, or robe-compatible armor
enhancements.name: Mirror-Flash Reversal
enhancements.preferred_materials: Mirror-sea silver, moon silver, stillwater jade
enhancements.text: When a creature you can see makes an attack roll against you, you can use your Reaction and spend 1 CP to impose Disadvantage on that roll. If it misses, you can move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature.

enhancements.name: Guardian Intercession Harness
enhancements.preferred_materials: World-turtle shell, mountain jade, spirit iron
enhancements.text: When an ally within 5 feet is hit by an attack, you can use your Reaction to exchange spaces with that ally if both spaces can hold you. You become the target of the attack, which is resolved against your Armor Class.

enhancements.name: Spirit-Guarding Hood
enhancements.preferred_materials: Soul jade, moon silver, enlightenment wood
enhancements.text: You have Advantage on saving throws against the Charmed and Frightened conditions and against possession.

enhancements.name: Void-Step Escape Lining
enhancements.preferred_materials: Voidglass, cloud-void crystal, moon silver thread
enhancements.text: When you take damage, you can use your Reaction and spend 2 CP to teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet after the damage resolves.

enhancements.name: Stone-Root Stabilizers
enhancements.preferred_materials: Mountain-root jade, heaven-bearing stone, heavy alloy
enhancements.text: At the start of your turn, you can spend 10 feet of movement to root the armor until the start of your next turn. While rooted on a solid surface, you cannot be moved against your will or knocked Prone unless you choose to be.

enhancements.name: Cloud-Walking Greaves
enhancements.preferred_materials: Cloud silk, feathered crystal, spirit bamboo
enhancements.text: During your turn, you can move across liquids and open air as though they were solid ground. If you end your turn unsupported, you fall.

enhancements.compatibility_text: Medium armor, heavy armor, or shield
enhancements.name: Iron Rain Deflection
enhancements.preferred_materials: Spirit iron, mountain jade, mirror silver
enhancements.text: Ranged weapon attacks against you have Disadvantage while you are at least 30 feet from the attacker. This does not affect siege weapons or attacks that ignore cover.

enhancements.name: Blood-Sealing Inner Layer
enhancements.preferred_materials: Blood jade, medicine silk, phoenix ash
enhancements.text: When you would drop to 0 Hit Points but not die outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once used, this property cannot be used again until you complete a Long Rest.

enhancements.name: Regenerative Lacquer
enhancements.preferred_materials: Living lacquer, phoenix ash, verdant gold
enhancements.text: Whenever you spend one or more Hit Dice to regain Hit Points, regain additional Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. The item also repairs itself fully during the rest.

enhancements.name: Law-Resisting Seal Plates
enhancements.preferred_materials: Sealing jade, heaven-mark gold, spirit iron
enhancements.text: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells, Sphere actions, treasure effects, and other explicitly supernatural effects.

enhancements.compatibility_text: Cloth, robe-compatible, hide, or concealable armor
enhancements.name: Concealing Mist Mantle
enhancements.preferred_materials: Cloud silk, moon silver thread, smoke crystal
enhancements.text: The armor has 3 Mist charges and regains 1d3 charges after a Long Rest. As a Bonus Action, expend 1 charge to become Invisible until the start of your next turn or until you make an attack, deal damage, or force a saving throw.

enhancements.compatibility_text: Medium armor, heavy armor, or shield
enhancements.name: Thorn-Retaliation Plates
enhancements.preferred_materials: Thornwood, dragon scale, hooked plate
enhancements.text: Whenever a creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, it takes piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

enhancements.name: Cold-Iron Spirit Cage
enhancements.preferred_materials: Ghost iron, deepsea cold iron, soul jade
enhancements.text: A possessing creature cannot enter you while you are conscious. If an effect would possess you despite this property, you have Advantage on the saving throw and the possessing creature takes psychic damage equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus on a failed attempt.

enhancements.name: Formation-Circuit Armor
enhancements.preferred_materials: Formation jade, spirit iron, source stone
enhancements.text: While you are inside a friendly Formation, add 1 to saving throws and to your item save DC. This bonus does not stack with another Formation-Circuit Armor.

enhancements.name: Second-Skin Transformation
enhancements.preferred_materials: Cloud silk, voidglass, living lacquer
enhancements.text: As an Action, the armor folds into a Tiny ornament or unfolds around you. Transforming it does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. While folded, it provides no Armor Class or other worn benefits.

enhancements.name: Shield-Link Inscription
enhancements.preferred_materials: World-turtle shell, mountain jade, spirit iron
enhancements.text: An ally within 5 feet of you gains Half Cover while you wield the shield and are not Incapacitated. This does not stack with other Half Cover.

enhancements.name: Deflecting Shield Face
enhancements.preferred_materials: Mirror silver, mountain jade, spirit iron
enhancements.text: When you or an ally within 5 feet takes damage from an attack, use your Reaction and spend 1 CP to reduce the damage by `2d8 + your Proficiency Bonus`.

enhancements.name: Heaven-Breath Filter
enhancements.preferred_materials: Cloud silk, medicine jade, spirit filters
enhancements.text: You can breathe normally in smoke, gas, underwater, and in airless environments for up to 1 hour. Afterward, the filter must recharge during a Short or Long Rest.

enhancements.name: Sovereign Resistance Matrix
enhancements.preferred_materials: Five-phase alloy, dragon scale, calamity gold
enhancements.text: Choose two damage types from acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, psychic, radiant, necrotic, or thunder when the enhancement is created. You have Resistance to both chosen types.

enhancements.compatibility_text: Mountain, plate, heavy armor, or shield
enhancements.name: Mountain-Pattern Fortress
enhancements.preferred_materials: Mountain-root jade, heaven-bearing stone, world-turtle shell
enhancements.text: Reduce all damage you take by your Proficiency Bonus after applying Resistance. This property cannot reduce damage below 1.

enhancements.name: Mirror-Heaven Counter
enhancements.preferred_materials: Mirror-sea silver, moon silver, stillwater jade
enhancements.text: When an attack made by a creature you can see damages you, use your Reaction and spend 2 CP to reduce the damage by `4d8 + your Proficiency Bonus`. If reduced to 0, make a ranged item attack against the attacker within 120 feet; on a hit, it takes 4d8 force damage.

enhancements.name: Walking Barrier Mantle
enhancements.preferred_materials: World-turtle shell, voidglass, formation jade
enhancements.text: The armor has 5 Barrier charges and regains `1d4 + 1` after a Long Rest. As a Bonus Action, expend 2 charges to gain a barrier with 30 Hit Points for 1 minute. Damage is dealt to the barrier before you. The barrier has your AC and ends at 0 Hit Points.

enhancements.name: Space-Folded Evasion
enhancements.preferred_materials: Cloud-void crystal, voidglass, cloud silk
enhancements.text: When an attack roll would hit you, use your Reaction and spend 2 CP to teleport up to 30 feet to a visible unoccupied space. If the new space is outside the attack's reach or line, the attack misses; otherwise, it is resolved normally.

enhancements.name: Ancestral Battle-Dress Spirit
enhancements.preferred_materials: Soul jade, heaven-mark gold, ancestral cloth
enhancements.text: The armor contains an awakened ancestral instinct. You cannot be surprised while conscious, and when you roll initiative with 0 Temporary Hit Points, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus.

enhancements.name: Elemental Conversion Shell
enhancements.preferred_materials: Five-phase alloy, dragon scale, calamity gold
enhancements.text: At the end of each Short or Long Rest, choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. You have Resistance to that type, and when you take damage of that type, you can change it to another type from the list before applying Resistance.

enhancements.name: Ninefold Dragon Guard
enhancements.preferred_materials: Dragon scale, abyssal gold, mountain jade
enhancements.text: When you take the Utilize action to raise the shield, choose a 15-foot cone originating from you until the start of your next turn. You and allies in the cone have Three-Quarters Cover against attacks and effects originating outside the cone.

enhancements.name: Ten-Thousand Plate Domain
enhancements.preferred_materials: Heaven-mark gold, world-turtle shell, formation jade
enhancements.text: The armor has 5 Domain charges and regains `1d4 + 1` after a Long Rest. As an Action, expend 3 charges to create a 20-foot Emanation for 1 minute, requiring Concentration. Allies in the area reduce all damage they take by your Proficiency Bonus. Hostile creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain.

enhancements.name: Heaven-Veil Imperial Robe
enhancements.preferred_materials: Cloud silk, immortal-tear gold, heaven-mark gold
enhancements.text: You have Resistance to force damage. When a creature within 60 feet damages you, use your Reaction and spend 2 CP to make a ranged item attack against it. On a hit, it takes 6d8 force damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

enhancements.name: Calamity-Sheltering Shell
enhancements.preferred_materials: Calamity-tempered gold, tribulation steel, dragon scale
enhancements.text: When you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead. Afterward, this enhancement becomes dormant until you complete a Long Rest. While dormant, it provides no benefit.

enhancements.name: Immovable Mountain Grand Shell
enhancements.preferred_materials: Mother-weight essence, abyssal gold, heaven-bearing stone
enhancements.text: You cannot be moved against your will, knocked Prone, or teleported against your will while conscious. You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and whether another creature can Grapple or Shove you.

enhancements.name: Voidless Sanctuary Armor
enhancements.preferred_materials: Origin-void copper, world-heart crystal, voidglass
enhancements.text: You and allied creatures within 10 feet cannot be teleported or moved between planes against your will. Teleportation into the area by a hostile creature requires a Charisma saving throw against your item save DC; on a failure, the teleportation is wasted.

enhancements.name: Heaven-Turning Shield Face
enhancements.preferred_materials: Abyssal gold, mirror-sea silver, world-turtle shell
enhancements.text: The shield has 3 Turning charges and regains 1 charge after a Long Rest. When a line, cone, or ranged attack would affect you, use your Reaction and expend 1 charge. You gain Total Cover against that effect until it resolves. If it is a line or ranged attack, choose a new legal direction or target for the effect from your space.

materials.compatible_profiles: Lamellar, plate, ring, and shield profiles
materials.name: Hundred-Fold Steel Plates
materials.property_text: **Layered Hardness.** Reduce bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage you take from nonmagical attacks by 1. This reduction applies after Resistance.

materials.compatible_profiles: Hide, leather, flexible, and beast-compatible profiles
materials.name: Lacquered Beast Hide
materials.property_text: **Sealed Hide.** The armor is not damaged by ordinary rain, saltwater, mold, rot, or humidity. You have Advantage on saving throws against environmental cold caused by wet clothing or exposure.

materials.compatible_profiles: Cloth, padded, layered, and robe-compatible profiles
materials.name: Hundred-Layer Battle Cotton
materials.property_text: **Impact Padding.** Reduce falling and collision damage you take by 2. The armor can be used as bedding without becoming damaged or unusable.

materials.compatible_profiles: Lamellar, shield, light, and medium profiles
materials.name: Rattan-Bamboo Lamellae
materials.opposed_text: Fire and heavy Weight enhancements unless stabilized
materials.property_text: **Buoyant Weave.** The armor weighs half as much as normal. While conscious, you float in calm water and have Advantage on checks made to avoid sinking.

materials.compatible_profiles: Lamellar, hide, shield, and beast-compatible profiles
materials.name: Spirit-Beast Bone Lamellae
materials.property_text: **Nonmetal Shell.** The armor is nonmetallic and immune to ordinary rust. Effects that specifically target metal armor do not treat it as metal.

materials.compatible_profiles: Cloth, layered, concealable, and robe-compatible profiles
materials.name: Paper-Lamellar Scripture Sheets
materials.property_text: **Folded Construction.** Donning or doffing the armor takes half the normal time. A creature has Disadvantage on a visual-only check to recognize it as armor while it is covered by ordinary robes.

materials.compatible_profiles: Any metal-compatible armor or shield
materials.name: Spirit Iron Lamellae
materials.property_text: **Qi-Conductive Shell.** While wearing the armor, you can use it as a focus for Sphere actions and treasure activations that require a worn or held focus. The armor counts as magical before receiving an enhancement.

materials.compatible_profiles: Cloth, flexible, robe-compatible, and concealable armor
materials.name: Cloud Silk
materials.opposed_text: Weight and heavy Earth enhancements unless stabilized
materials.property_text: **Weightless Draping.** The armor weighs one-quarter as much as normal. It does not impose Disadvantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.

materials.compatible_profiles: Metal-compatible, lamellar, ring, and plate armor
materials.name: Storm Iron Mesh
materials.property_text: **Grounded Circuit.** Reduce lightning damage you take by your Proficiency Bonus. If this reduces the damage to 0, the armor emits a harmless crack of thunder audible to 100 feet.

materials.compatible_profiles: Cloth, lamellar lacing, hidden plate, and mirror armor
materials.name: Moon Silver Thread
materials.preferred_enhancements: Illusion Guard, Concealment, Spirit Guard, Mirror
materials.property_text: **Pale Reflection.** You have Advantage on ability checks made to discern visual illusions affecting your clothing, armor, reflection, or immediate space.

materials.compatible_profiles: Plate, lamellar, shield, and metal-compatible armor
materials.name: Sun Copper Plates
materials.opposed_text: Deep Yin and Cold unless stabilized
materials.preferred_enhancements: Fire Guard, Radiance, Vitality, Fear Resistance
materials.property_text: **Warm Circulation.** Reduce cold and necrotic damage you take by 1. The armor remains comfortably warm in ordinary freezing weather.

materials.compatible_profiles: Scale, lamellar, flexible, and shield profiles
materials.name: River Jade Scales
materials.property_text: **Flowing Fit.** The armor imposes no penalty on swimming. If you lack a Swim Speed, you can swim at your normal Speed while wearing it.

materials.compatible_profiles: Lamellar, plate, shield, and mountain profiles
materials.name: Frost Jade Segments
materials.property_text: **Cold Preservation.** Reduce fire damage you take by 1. The armor and anything stored in its ordinary pockets are protected from ordinary environmental heat.

materials.compatible_profiles: Hide, leather, flexible, and beast-compatible armor
materials.name: Spirit-Beast Hide
materials.preferred_enhancements: Tracking, Mobility, Natural Weapons, Spirit Guard
materials.property_text: **Beast Adaptation.** When the armor is created, choose Climb, Swim, or Harsh Climate. You gain a Climb Speed of 10 feet, a Swim Speed of 10 feet, or Advantage on saving throws against ordinary extreme heat and cold, according to the choice.

materials.compatible_profiles: Lamellar, plate, mountain, shield, and full-coverage armor
materials.name: Mountain-Root Jade Plates
materials.opposed_text: Air and weightless movement unless stabilized
materials.property_text: **Mountain-Root Stability.** Forced movement affecting you is reduced by 10 feet. You have Advantage on saving throws against being knocked Prone.

materials.compatible_profiles: Lamellar, plate, hide, and full-coverage armor
materials.name: Dragon Scale Lamellae
materials.opposed_text: An element opposed to the dragon source
materials.property_text: **Draconic Resistance.** Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison when the armor is created. You have Resistance to the chosen damage type while wearing it.

materials.compatible_profiles: Cloth, robe-compatible, flexible, and hidden armor
materials.name: Phoenix-Ash Silk
materials.property_text: **Rekindled Weave.** You have Resistance to fire damage. If the armor is destroyed but not disintegrated, placing its remains in a magical fire for 8 hours restores it.

materials.compatible_profiles: Ring, lamellar, plate, and metal-compatible armor
materials.name: Ghost Iron Mail
materials.preferred_enhancements: Spirit Guard, Possession Defense, Ghost Ward
materials.property_text: **Ethereal Barrier.** Incorporeal creatures cannot move through your space unless you permit it. You have Advantage on saving throws against possession.

materials.compatible_profiles: Lamellar, plate, mirror, and shield profiles
materials.name: Voidglass Scales
materials.property_text: **Folded Surface.** Reduce force damage you take by your Proficiency Bonus. Effects cannot teleport the armor away from you while you are attuned to it.

materials.compatible_profiles: Lamellar, ring, hidden plate, and beast-compatible armor
materials.name: Blood Jade Links
materials.property_text: **Blood Recognition.** You have Advantage on death saving throws. A creature other than the attuned bearer has Disadvantage on checks made to remove the armor against the bearer's will.

materials.compatible_profiles: Mirror, plate, lamellar, and shield profiles
materials.name: Mirror-Sea Silver
materials.property_text: **Still Mirror.** You have Advantage on saving throws against visual illusions and gaze effects. A creature relying on a reflected gaze treats the armor as a valid mirror.

materials.compatible_profiles: Plate, lamellar, heavy, shield, and full-coverage armor
materials.name: Deepsea Cold Iron
materials.property_text: **Abyssal Pressure.** You have Resistance to cold damage and suffer no harm from ordinary deep-water pressure within the campaign's normal adventuring environments.

materials.compatible_profiles: Any metal-compatible armor or shield
materials.name: Tribulation Steel
materials.property_text: **Calamity Memory.** You have Resistance to lightning and thunder damage. When you succeed on a saving throw against either type, the armor becomes charged until the end of your next turn; the first creature that hits you with a melee attack while charged takes lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

materials.compatible_profiles: Lamellar, plate, ring, shield, and metal-compatible armor
materials.name: Five-Phase Alloy
materials.property_text: **Balanced Protection.** At the end of each Long Rest, choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. You have Resistance to the chosen damage type until you choose again.

materials.compatible_profiles: Plate, lamellar, mirror, helmeted, and full-coverage armor
materials.name: Soul Jade Plates
materials.property_text: **Soul Resonance.** You have Resistance to psychic damage and Advantage on saving throws against possession or effects that would directly control your actions.

materials.compatible_profiles: Mountain, plate, shield, and heavy armor
materials.name: Heaven-Bearing Stone
materials.property_text: **Bearing the Blow.** Reduce all damage you take by 2 after applying Resistance. This property cannot reduce damage below 1.

materials.compatible_profiles: Plate, lamellar, mirror, and robe-integrated armor
materials.name: Cloud-Void Crystal
materials.property_text: **Spatial Lightness.** The armor weighs nothing while worn by its attuned bearer. It imposes no Strength requirement and cannot reduce the bearer's Speed.

materials.compatible_profiles: Shield, plate, mountain, and full-coverage heavy armor
materials.name: World-Turtle Shell
materials.property_text: **Ancient Shell.** Your Hit Point maximum increases by twice your Proficiency Bonus while wearing the armor. The armor weighs twice as much as its normal profile unless an Attunement property negates the weight.

materials.compatible_profiles: Plate, lamellar, mirror, and full-coverage armor
materials.name: Phoenix-Blood Scarlet Gold
materials.opposed_text: Deep Yin unless stabilized by an Imperial material
materials.preferred_enhancements: Fire Guard, Rebirth, Radiance, Armor Spirit
materials.property_text: **Phoenix Authority.** You are immune to ordinary environmental fire and have Resistance to fire damage. The first time each Long Rest the armor would be destroyed, it becomes dormant at 1 Hit Point instead.

materials.compatible_profiles: Any metal-compatible armor or shield
materials.name: Heaven-Mark Violet Gold
materials.preferred_enhancements: Dao Vessel, Armor Spirit, Integration, Growth
materials.property_text: **Natural Dao Surface.** The armor's enchantment capacity increases by +1 Equivalent Bonus.

materials.compatible_profiles: Plate, lamellar, shield, and full-coverage armor
materials.name: Calamity-Tempered Imperial Gold
materials.preferred_enhancements: Calamity Guard, Saving Throws, Barrier, Retaliation
materials.property_text: **Tribulation Guard.** When you finish a Short or Long Rest, choose acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, radiant, or thunder. You have Resistance to the chosen type until you choose again.

materials.compatible_profiles: Plate, lamellar, mirror, and robe-integrated armor
materials.name: Immortal-Tear Verdant Gold
materials.property_text: **Sanctuary Metal.** You have Resistance to necrotic and radiant damage. Allied creatures within 5 feet of you have Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened.

materials.compatible_profiles: Heavy armor, shield, mountain, and full-coverage armor
materials.name: Dragon-Patterned Abyssal Gold
materials.property_text: **Dragon Pressure.** You have Resistance to force damage. Forced movement affecting you is reduced by 20 feet.
